import csv, sys
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

col1 = []
col2 = []
with open(sys.argv[1]) as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f, delimiter="\t")
    header = next(reader)
    for row in reader:
        try:
            v1 = float(row[1])
            v2 = float(row[2])
            col1.append(v1)
            col2.append(v2)
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            continue

rho, pval = spearmanr(col1, col2)
with open("result.tsv", "w") as out:
    out.write("spearman_rho\tp_value\n")
    out.write(f"{rho}\t{pval}\n")
